informational: ds-date-picker's panel now closes when ANY ancestor scroll container scrolls, not only the one 0.6.0 watched. Nothing to change: a panel that used to hang over the page while a nested pane scrolled underneath now dismisses itself.

ds-date-picker masked typing works on mobile keyboards. Segment-aware editing was wired to keydown, which soft keyboards (Gboard among them) do not report faithfully; the mobile path now goes through beforeinput. If you shipped a workaround that bypassed the masked field on touch devices, it can go.

ds-date-picker's panel no longer sets aria-modal. The calendar is non-modal - the page stays interactive behind it - so the attribute told screen readers something untrue. No API changed; an assistive-tech test that asserted aria-modal on this panel needs updating.
